rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, line 4: "Divide line 2 by the number on line 3. If you completed this worksheet last year, enter the amount from line 4 of last year’s worksheet", and Tables 1 and 2 ("after November 18, 1996" column: 360, 310, 260, 210, 160; Table 2: 410, 360, 310, 260, 210). Ages are whole numbers, so the candidate's bands (age ≤ 55, 55 < age ≤ 60, ..., age > 70) equal the project's, and Table 2 likewise; the pre-November-19-1996 column is screened by retirement.special and retirement.annuity, as the earlier rulings record. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/retirement.json; 1,372 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 1,140 partial records): 2,528 of 2,528 agree. Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Ages are whole numbers, so the bands '56 to 60' written as 55 < age <= 60 and as 56 <= age < 61 are the same; Table 2 likewise.

Ruling: project retained. The difference the earlier ruling on this line settled, now from the other side: for a Simplified Method annuity whose cost has been recovered (worksheet line 7 zero), the second still shows box 1 on line 5a when box 5 is nonzero; the project shows nothing, since the payments are then fully taxable. i1040gi p. 28, Fully Taxable Pensions and Annuities, "you got your entire cost back tax free before 2025 ... If your pension or annuity is fully taxable, enter the total pension or annuity payments (from Form(s) 1099-R, box 1) on line 5b; don't make an entry on line 5a". Box 5 counts only for a plan distribution outside the Simplified Method (stage10.smw.cost_recovered_box5). The rollover and Roth conditions agree.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project's rollover amount is box 1 under code G and the rollover input otherwise, and every guard pairs it with 'code is not G' (or adds 'code is G'), so it reduces to the second's rollover input. The project's plan condition, (A and B) or not-a-plan, where A is 'box 5 is zero or this is a worksheet annuity' and B is 'worksheet line 7 is zero or less, or this is not a worksheet annuity', equals the second's (A or not-a-plan) and (B or not-a-plan) by distribution; the Roth condition is the same.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 29, Simplified Method Worksheet, line 1: "Enter the total pension or annuity payments from Form 1099-R, box 1. Also, enter this amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 5a". The candidate enters box 1 only when its taxable amount is below box 1, so a Simplified Method annuity whose worksheet line 8 is zero shows nothing on line 5a: generated 421 (completed; cost not yet recovered, last year's line 4 $0) project $29,413.54, candidate $0.00; generated 425 $17,673.46 vs $0.00. It also inherits the h_recovered_bad refusal of retirement.taxable (classm.tcw.15, completed: project $0.00, candidate refusal). Same expression as round 1. Project stands.

The candidate leaves line 4a/5a blank when its taxable amount equals box 1, so it inherits both errors of retirement.taxable: classm.tcw.15 (completed) project $0.00 (fully taxable, no line 5a entry), candidate $39,110.00, because its taxable amount $49,089.00 is not box 1; and a code G entry answered with a $0 rollover is fully taxable to it, so line 5a is blank (classm.aqee.1.deepseek, refused: project $45,285.00, candidate $0.00). By reading, as in round 2, it also leaves line 5a blank for a Simplified Method annuity whose worksheet line 8 is zero, against worksheet line 1. The project-refuses are cited gates (scope); the unknowns are partial records withholding answers asked of every entry. Project stands.

Ruling: project changed to the second's reading after this run. For a Simplified Method annuity whose cost has been recovered, the project still showed box 1 on line 5a when box 5 was nonzero; the payments are fully taxable then ('don't make an entry on line 5a', p. 28), so box 5 now counts only for a plan distribution outside the Simplified Method (retirement.show_a), and stage10.smw.cost_recovered_box5 asserts it. The guards otherwise agree.

If the total distribution wasn’t rolled over, enter the part not rolled over on line 4b"; i1040gi p. 30, Rollovers. The candidate's test (code G, or a rollover amount above zero) is the project's.
